description: Platform-owned sample catalogue: used cars and auctions from the earlier reviewed FYP seed (2026-10-05). Each photo is pinned by the address of its original on Wikimedia Commons, its size and its SHA-256; the seed downloads it, checks it and stores it. No owner, bids or accounts.
